name: Dr. Sari Sadiya
bio: I am a Principal Investigator at Constructor Knowledge Labs focusing on Human-AI Fusion & Cognitive Wearable Intelligence. Previously, I was a postdoctoral fellow working at Dr Gemma Roig's Computational Vision & AI lab at the Frankfurt Goethe University, and Dr Radoslaw Cichy's Neural Dynamics of Visual Cognition lab at Berlin.

name: Azamat Amanbay
bio: I’m a third-year Software, Data and Technology major at Constructor University Bremen. I have worked on projects involving computer vision and machine learning. I joined the lab in June 2026 and I’m focused on research within the wearables area, where I work on human activity recognition. Outside of work and university, I enjoy cooking, traveling, and exploring new places.

name: Sungat Serikbay
bio: I am a JetBrains Foundation Scholar pursuing a BSc in Software, Data, and Technology at Constructor University. Having won multiple national and international Olympiads in informatics and AI, I have a deep interest in advanced algorithms and artificial intelligence. At ARSU Lab, my work focuses on human activity recognition. In my free time, I enjoy hiking and traveling.
